name: lecture-notes
description: Turn lecture slides and transcripts into complete living notes in the current ChatGPT conversation, using Notion as the default editable Master Note.

interface.longDescription: Create and refine complete Master Notes directly in the current ChatGPT conversation, save them as editable Notion pages, and support iterative inline-comment follow-up. Do not hand lecture-note tasks off to Work unless the user explicitly requests Work. Google Docs remains an optional fallback/export destination.
capabilities: Complete lecture-note workflows directly in the current ChatGPT conversation
Create notes from slides and lecture transcripts
Preserve formulas, proofs, examples, and instructor additions
Read Notion comments attached to selected text
Insert explanations locally for iterative follow-up
Optionally create or update Google Docs
defaultPrompt: Complete this directly in the current ChatGPT conversation: create an editable Notion Master Note from my uploaded slides and transcript. Do not hand the task off to Work.
Process the comments I just added to my Notion lecture note directly in this chat and insert the answers beside the questioned text.
Check my current Master Note against the slides and transcript for missing knowledge points, directly in this chat.
